title: Educational Asset Metadata
description: Metadata contract for every reusable asset in assets/. Each asset lives in its own directory containing this file, a deterministic build script, and generated outputs. Validation is currently enforced by tools/validate.mjs (hand-rolled subset of this schema); swap to ajv if the schema grows complex.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Must match the directory name and must never be an implementation name like 'Cube.001'.

type.description: prop = laboratory/world object, molecular = conceptual atom/molecule representation, diagram = 2D explanatory element.

basis.description: 'real-world-scale' for laboratory objects at approximately true size; 'visualization-scale' for deliberately rescaled molecular/conceptual models.

dimensions.description: Approximate authored dimensions in scaleConvention units (informational).

simplifications.description: Every deliberate deviation from physical reality MUST be listed here (AGENTS.md sections 4 and 17).

generator.description: Path of the deterministic build script relative to the asset directory.

source.description: Required for external/scanned assets: origin URL or attribution.

license.description: Required for external assets, e.g. CC-BY-4.0. Use 'project-original' for in-house procedural assets.

three.description: How Three.js consumes this asset, e.g. path to exported .glb.

remotion.description: How Remotion compositions consume this asset.
